mapping.draft_py:
# Primeval Bounty (FDN), an enchantment for {5}{G}.
# "Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
#  Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
#  Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 3 life."
# [0] CastSpellEvent over creature spells you cast: M21 Spellgorger Weird's verified
#     "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell" (B2b-noncreature-counter) without the FNot; the token
#     is M21 Elder Gargaroth's verified 3/3 green Beast.
# [1] B2b-noncreature-counter's event (parses: `parse "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put
#     a +1/+1 counter on this creature."`); the effect is B5b-put-counter's "Put a +1/+1 counter
#     on target creature you control." (Feat of Resistance) with count 3.
# [2] B7-landfall-trigger (Kazandu Nectarpot) with the printed 3.
# Landfall is an ability word (CR 207.2c). The compiled cast carrier is kept.
creature_cast = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Beast',
            type_line='Creature — Beast',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Beast',),
            power=QConst(value=3),
            toughness=QConst(value=3),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('G',),
        ),
    }),
)
noncreature_cast = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature')),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=3),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
landfall = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=3), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [creature_cast, noncreature_cast, landfall, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 3 life.

mapping.notes: Creature-spell and noncreature-spell cast triggers (M21 Spellgorger Weird's event, verified), Elder Gargaroth's 3/3 Beast, Feat of Resistance's counter with count 3, ZNR Kazandu Nectarpot's landfall with 3 life; one landfall trigger per land. Pack: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/primeval_bounty_two_lands_at_once_gain_twice.json.
